did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. The price a shop (Karim Pharmacy) pays for Napa 500 mg was read after each step. The owner set a rate for the whole company Square (22%), then a rate for the one medicine (27%), then a hand-set rate for this one shop (18%). Each rate was saved on the owner's screens and the shop's price was read again.

checks.text: Before any of them the shop paid 247.50 a box (17.5% off the printed 300)
Company rate 22%: the shop pays 234.00 (the company rate beats the tier price)
Medicine rate 27%: the shop pays 219.00 (the rate for one medicine beats the company rate)
Hand-set rate for this shop, 18%: the shop pays 246.00, even though it is a smaller discount (the shop's own rate beats everything)

The screens say it in words: "A rate for one medicine beats the company rate. Both beat the tier. A shop with its own rate keeps it." and "Highest priority; overrides tier, company and medicine rates."

notes: Done by hand in the live browser, not by a script. Setting a rate needs the owner's password again, which is a safeguard. The test rates were removed afterwards.

shots.caption: A medicine rate below cost asks to confirm: "Raise it, or confirm to sell at a loss"
A hand-set rate for this shop: Napa 18% off
